verdict_reason: Type filter options, honoured and ignored roles, role-preserving page and Clear search links and role search are well covered, but the new ignored-role log line is untested.

todos.issue: The controller now logs 'Address book list ignored a role the tab does not offer' with organisationId, addressType and requestedRole (list.controller.js:144-149) whenever a role the tab does not offer is dropped, but no test asserts it. The role-ignored cases here (lines 71-88 ?role=IMPORTER / ?role=TRANSPORTER, and lines 90-104 ?addressType=BRANCH&role=CONSIGNOR) only check the request and the select; deleting the log call leaves every test green. The sibling address-type log is pinned in list.tabs.controller.test.js:67-117 with captureInfoLogs, so the pattern exists.
todos.fix: Must: a test fails if the ignored-role log line is removed or loses organisationId, addressType or requestedRole, and a test proves an empty role (?role=) and an offered role log nothing. One way: add a describe using captureInfoLogs() beside the role-ignored cases, asserting infoLogs('Address book list ignored a role the tab does not offer') equals one entry with { organisationId: ORGANISATION_ID, addressType: 'BRANCH', requestedRole: 'CONSIGNOR' }, and [] for ?role= and ?role=BRANCH_ADDRESS on the Branch tab, mirroring list.tabs.controller.test.js:67-117.
